label: Typed spatial queries
subgoals: Define each query's inputs with layer, coordinates and units
Return structured records with the numbers a fix needs
Map each tool onto a window or distance query in the index

label: Bounded, deterministic results
subgoals: Cap the response size and report the total count
Sort results by a stable key
Invalidate cached results when edits touch their region

section: Cost and safety at the tool boundary
